surface: Official VS Code Linux x64 stable portable desktop, isolated Xvfb display :99 (1600x1000), isolated DBus session, profile and extensions directory. Installation and UI are still available under /tmp/nacre-v7-vscode for follow-up; no repository files were edited.

workspace.compiler_check: Passed: nacre check on the two-source workspace.
workspace.examples: readonly receiver-derived borrowed getter with a local reborrow; owned field replacement; getRef/getMut on nominal list elements; borrowed and mutable-borrowed matching on an enum with nominal payloads.

observations.language_association: Both .ncr editors displayed Nacre as the VS Code language; syntax colors for borrow, borrow mut, match, and borrowed-match expressions were visible.
observations.loan_diagnostic: An element borrow remained live at entries.remove(0); the Problems panel showed E3001. After putting the element borrow in a shorter lexical scope, the Problems panel reported no problems.
observations.diagnostic_localization: The UI showed localized human-readable diagnostic text; only the E3001 identifier is transcribed here.
observations.unsaved_cross_file_overlay: In the UI, renamed Helper.ncr getter label to caption without saving; the open Main.ncr then displayed a cross-file unknown-getter diagnostic. Undo restored label and cleared diagnostics.

restart.command: Nacre: Restart Language Server, invoked in the Command Palette.

observations.close_reopen: Closed both valid source editor tabs, reopened Main.ncr from Explorer, and observed the Nacre language association with no diagnostics.
observations.snippet: Typed bmatch in a real .ncr editor, saw the Borrowed enum match completion and preview, and accepted it to insert the expansion through the UI. The temporary scratch editor/source was removed afterward.
observations.initial_launch_note: A preliminary file-only window did not load workspace settings and logged spawn nacre ENOENT. Restarting with the workspace folder loaded the absolute nacre.serverPath, launched the compiler at the configured path, and passed the interaction checks. The exact exploratory logs are retained; this was not a compiler or extension source bug.
